exposure: matched period in the previous year
outcome: Admission rates to the delivery room
Admission rates to the feto-maternal unit
Rate of active labor on admission
Rate of premature rupture of membranes
cohort: Women > 20 weeks pregnant who presented to the obstetrical emergency department with self-complaints
finding: This study found that the COVID-19 pandemic was associated with delayed presentation to the obstetrical emergency department, leading to a significant increase in urgent and acute interventions, but no change in maternal or neonatal morbidity.
